rule: Revenue and customer spending calculations must include only completed orders.
Cancelled orders must be excluded from revenue and customer spending calculations.
Order revenue is calculated as product price multiplied by ordered quantity.
Customer spending is the sum of product price multiplied by quantity for products purchased through completed orders.
Customers must be connected to orders using customers.id = orders.customer_id.
Orders must be connected to order_items using orders.id = order_items.order_id.
Products must be connected to order_items using products.id = order_items.product_id.
